title.description: Shown at the top of the page, e.g. 'E1 dry run'.

context.description: Optional note shown to raters (what the code is for, not what changed).

meta.description: HIDDEN from raters. Use tally.py --strip to make the public file you send out.

before.description: Which side is the original code; the other side is the agent-refactored 'after'.

score_delta.description: score(after) - score(before), signed so that positive means the score judges 'after' clearer, negative means 'before' clearer, 0 means a tie. Not needed for E5.
